items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I haven't heard much of Jim Noon, but Johnny Dodds.

ctx.x: Did you like the Karnath players on those records? Oh yeah. Jim Noon.
I haven't heard much of Jim Noon, but Johnny Dodds. You liked this playing, huh? I admired this style.

Well, getting back to the bands at these picnics, there would be six pieces. Yeah, that's right. And there'd be a clarinet, and what else? A clarinet, a tromborong, a trumpet, a bass, a drum, and a band. I understand you. Do they play anything like that? Do they play Dixieland now, would you say?

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Jimmy Noon, Johnny Dyes, Lorenzo Teo, that's my favourite.

ctx.x: Did you ever get to hear
Jimmy Noon? Jimmy Noon, Johnny Dyes, Lorenzo Teo, that's my favourite.
